notes.title: SCARS ABOVE - PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850423/4f20bd3a414a1c011711f660f840799d86e1ef8b.png[/img]

Hey everyone, 

Apologies for the silence; we investigated the freezes reported with the last issue and are happy to share that a fix was deployed today to mend this. 

We are sorry for this unintended last change and hope you will now be able to continue your adventures without technical troubles! 
  

[h1]Additional Bugfixes:[/h1] 

[h2]Gameplay related improvements: [/h2]
[list]
[*] The game will now correctly pause, when a controller is disconnected. 
[*] Added a fallback option for the first boss, to make the journey between attempts a little bit easier. 
[*] Added an option for Sprint to be selectable to use hold button vs. toggle in the game options. 
[*] Fixed a rare blocker, where a gate in the snow area could not be opened as intended by destroying the power pylons. 
[*] Fixed a pulse scan related issue, where already looted items would remain highlighted. 
[*] Fixed a blocker, where the Credits would be displayed on loop after successfully finishing the game. 
[*] Fixed a controller related blocker, that could lock up player controls, when connecting a controller during an active cutscene. 
[*] Fixed a random crash, that was caused by reconnecting a controller under certain conditions.
[/list]
  
[h2]Graphics related improvements: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed a Fog FX in the Metahedron, which could cause some issuers performance issues unintendedly. 
[*] Improved the range of view in the Swamp level, to avoid assets popping in at far distances at times. 
[/list]

[h2]Options related issues: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Motion blur can now normally turned on/off. 
[*] Fixed a Graphics options issue, where changes would be accepted, event when a user chose to not save said changes. 
[*] Added some missing Icons for key binds. 
[/list]

[h2]Achievement related fixes: [/h2]
[list]
[*] "Scientific Collection" sometimes lost progress, when a played died under certain conditions. 
[*] Fixed "Flash and Bones" to always get correctly rewarded, when fulfilling all criteria. 
[*] Fixed "Face the Nightmare" to always get correctly rewarded, when fulfilling all criteria. 
[/list]
  
[h2]Steam Deck: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a player related issue, which caused videos to not be displayed correctly.
[/list] 

[h2]Sound related improvements: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved a sound issue, that sometimes caused the hypothermia warning to play double, or even when Kate is not affected by said effect at times. 
[*] General audio mix improvements, to address user feedback and improve the overall quality. 
[*] Fixed some Sound event related issues, which caused sounds under certain conditions to deteriorate. 
[*] Fixed some Sound effects to not play correctly, depending on the landscape the player is located on. 
[*] Improved sound warnings for Scorpiod enemies to be more distinct, and less frequent.
[/list]

[h1]What is Scars Above?[/h1]
Created by Serbian developer [b]Mad Head Games[/b] and published by [b]Prime Matter[/b], Scars Above is a challenging sci-fi third-person action, set in a mysterious alien world. 

[h2]The plot:[/h2]
A colossal and enigmatic alien structure appears in Earth's orbit and stuns the entire world; humanity names it ‘The Metahedron’. The Sentient Contact Assessment and Response team (SCAR) - consisting of scientists and engineers - is sent to investigate.  

Things don’t go as planned and the Metahedron hauls the team across space onto a mysterious extrasolar plane. 

It’s here that Kate (our heroine) wakes up alone on a strange and hostile world; determined to survive,  she sets out to find your crew and unravel the mystery behind what’s happened.

Greetings from space,

There are a few days left to enjoy the thrilling demo of Scars Above, available during the Steam Next Fest, [b]until October 10th[/b]! ⌛

[h2]What is Scars Above?[/h2]

Scars Above is a challenging sci-fi third-person action adventure shooter - set on a mysterious alien world – which has players facing a plethora of challenges as they unravel an intricate and compelling storyline.

The game follows the journey of Dr Kate Ward, an astronaut – part of a team of scientists and engineers - sent to investigate the appearance of a colossal and enigmatic alien structure in Earth's orbit.

As the team approaches this structure – named the Metahedron – they get transported across space onto a mysterious extrasolar planet. And it’s here you find yourself dazed and confused, alone in a strange, hostile environment. Determined to survive, you set out to find your crew and unravel the mystery behind what’s happened.

[h2]About the demo[/h2]

This demo starts shortly after the prologue and continues throughout the entirety of the game’s first chapter, giving you an idea of the main game mechanics that shape Scars Above and putting your skills to the test.

We’re eager to hear your feedback and your thoughts about this out-of-this-world adventure.
